[Branded Content] Before the name ever found its way onto a fuel tank, Bonneville was an obsession with speed born on the salt flats.
To see how that spirit survived over decades of change, Varun Painter and Arezwa Engineer rode two generations of the icon… a 1976 Triumph Bonneville T140 and a modern 2018 Triumph Bonneville T100, from Jaipur straight out onto the salt flats of Sambhar. Two motorcycles, four decades apart, chasing the exact same feeling.
Now, as Triumph turns the page with the all-new T40, we look back at what carrying this badge really means.
